Why These Examples Matter

These 23 websites demonstrate that Tailwind CSS powers some of the web’s most successful applications. From Netflix’s entertainment platform to Vercel’s developer tools, major companies trust Tailwind for mission-critical applications serving millions of users.

Each example reveals different approaches to common design challenges. Whether you’re building API documentation like Algolia, creating an e-commerce experience like Feastables, or developing a SaaS platform like Intercom, these real-world implementations provide valuable patterns to study.

The diversity of industries here proves Tailwind’s versatility. Financial platforms, content management systems, developer tools, and entertainment sites all benefit from its utility-first approach. If you’re working on admin dashboard interfaces, you’ll find particularly relevant patterns in how these companies structure their navigation and data presentation.

Key implementation insights:

  • Tailwind scales from startup MVPs to enterprise applications
  • Dark mode implementations vary significantly across different use cases
  • Custom design systems can coexist seamlessly with Tailwind utilities
  • Performance remains excellent even on high-traffic production sites

Study these examples for inspiration, but adapt their patterns to your specific needs. The most successful Tailwind implementations solve real user problems while maintaining clean, maintainable code that your team can work with long-term.
